record.note: Initial queries were batched. Returned items were assigned to the official issuer domain and frozen before body opens. Titles and snippets can expose source content; this was not content-blind collection. No recipient material was read.
Initial directory parser expected heading elements and returned zero cards; inspected DOM showed title divs. Corrected enumeration and froze 21 cards before opening any linked candidate.
Web-reader access restriction on MBTA was observed; official direct byte retrieval succeeded. No mirrored or unofficial text substituted.

Initial 2025 URLs returned 503 and 404 to official byte capture. Cached web-reader text was observed but not used as a raw original. Official /equity/ parent meta-redirect led to current civil-rights policy link.

Root provider-only clarification: eligibility requires explicit operating-service change—timetable/frequency/span, route-service configuration, or suspension/change procedure. Construction clearance or stop-location-only works without an explicit operating-service change rule do not meet the field. Applied to the already frozen candidate order before any recipient read.

First otherwise eligible category original was the 2017 SRTP. Exact-phrase official family query found 2019 and 2022 editions. Latest 2022 narrative was opened and selected under mandatory latest-edition rule; 2017/2019 remain edition-chain observations, not additional minimum documents.
